ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

2. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x > 5

3. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 4
   D. 12

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 15
   C. 17
   D. 13

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

7. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

8. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

9. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 13
   D. 37

10. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 28
   C. 3
   D. 29

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

12. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — 169
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 13² = 13 × 13
3. 13² = 169
Final Answer: 169
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. D — x > 5

3. B — 8
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 12 − 4
3. x = 8
Final Answer: x = 8
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

4. D — 144
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
